name: microservices-aca
description: Azure Container Apps with Dapr pub/sub over Service Bus, a Cosmos Dapr state store, an external API and an internal worker, scaled by KEDA - all keyless.
what: A Container Apps environment with Dapr enabled and two services: an externally-exposed API and an internal worker. Dapr components wire a Cosmos DB state store and a Service Bus topic pub/sub, both authenticated with a shared user-assigned managed identity. The worker scales on Service Bus queue depth via a keyless KEDA rule. Service Bus and Cosmos have local auth disabled.
why: Microservices teams want async messaging, durable state, and event-driven autoscaling without running Kubernetes or managing broker credentials. Container Apps + Dapr provides the building-block APIs while Service Bus and Cosmos supply the backbone - and managed identity removes every connection string.
potentialUseCases: Order processing / saga workflows with a worker pool
Decoupled command and event services behind a single gateway
Burst-scaling background processing off a queue
Polyglot microservices needing portable state and pub/sub

reliability: Zone-redundant environment and Premium Service Bus in prod
Multiple replicas keep the worker warm in prod
security: Local auth disabled on Service Bus and Cosmos
Shared user-assigned identity with least-privilege data-plane roles
External ingress is HTTPS-only; worker has no ingress
costOptimization: Scale-to-zero API and Standard Service Bus in dev
KEDA scales the worker to queue depth
operationalExcellence: Dapr telemetry and container logs flow to App Insights / Log Analytics
Dapr decouples app code from broker and store specifics
performanceEfficiency: Event-driven autoscaling matches compute to backlog
Concurrency-based HTTP scaling on the API

quota.summary: Azure Container Apps must be available in the target region. Container Apps Consumption has no blocking vCPU quota; Service Bus and Cosmos have no regional quota gate.

requirements.detail: The Container Apps managed environment must be offered in the target region.

cost.profile: Prod profile: zone-redundant environment, Premium Service Bus, warm replicas.
